notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.content: [p]This update contains new Pomodoro App, fixed nightstands center points and some minor fixes.[/p][p][/p][p]• New Pomodoro App. Set up your goals and time to complete with the rewards you want to receive![/p][p]• Fixed all nightstands issue with them not being centered. Might require to replace them slightly on your current save files[/p][p]• Minor fixes[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.content: [p]This update contains several QoL updates and bug fixes.[/p][p][/p][p]• Increased maximum task reward from 150 to 999 [/p][p]• Fixed board game "Wish & Rent" price from 0 to 100 [/p][p]• Fixed scrolling tasks list [/p][p]• Fixed getting Meteorologist achievement after loading your save file[/p]

notes.title: Development Diary #5. Construction of the main room
notes.content:
Today I would like to share the construction of a complete room. The game will have several rooms available to the player for furnishing: the main room (bedroom), kitchen and bathroom. Perhaps with new updates, the possibility of expanding the player's apartment will be added.

Check this out:

[previewyoutube=tMaJXxdXnO4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]***[/h1]
More cool development news coming soon! Good luck to all!
In the meantime, you can add the game to your wishlist or follow the development on my [url=https://twitter.com/ChillApartment]Twitter[/url].

notes.title: Development Diary #4. Improved build mode and lighting occlusion
notes.content:
Today I would like to share the progress of work on the updated build mode. There will be 3 types of placeable objects in the game: floor (beds, tables, chairs, etc.), wall-mounted (shelves, paintings, etc.) and decor, which can be placed both on the floor and on other objects, according to type of tables and shelves.

Check this out:

[previewyoutube=sokqbYIa-fk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]***[/h1]
More cool development news coming soon! Good luck to all!
In the meantime, you can add the game to your wishlist or follow the development on my [url=https://twitter.com/ChillApartment]Twitter[/url].
